title: Cold Storage: The Faces We Left Behind
premise: Eight DHFs who exposed pieces of Project Palimpsest in 2274 awaken in unfamiliar sleeves. The people they knew have new faces, and each PC carries one hidden fragment of the evidence archive.

scenes.name: The Resurrection Ward
minimum: Each active PC learns the physical facts of their current sleeve
Reveal the 110-year gap
Show the two reserve/missing bays
optional: Private sensory complication from a sleeve
Marlowe fragment on a damaged terminal
scenes.cut: Skip individual medical examinations and deliver sleeve complications as dossier cards.
scenes.failureForward: No roll can prevent the PCs from leaving the ward; failed checks reveal that logs were deliberately cleaned.
clues: Current sleeves were paid for anonymously
The two reserve bays are not empty by accident
scenes.spotlight: Every selected PC states one thing that feels physically wrong or unfamiliar.

scenes.name: Breach of Cold Storage
minimum: Run one full Intent → Check → Resolution teaching cycle
Attackers demonstrate that intact stacks are the objective
Deliver first relationship familiarity trigger
scenes.cut: End the attackers’ morale after one complete combat Turn once the players understand Speed Dice.
scenes.failureForward: If overwhelmed, facility countermeasures or a contact opens an escape route; the consequence is lost equipment, not a dead-end.
clues: Protectorate-format authorization with a private corporate checksum
One attacker uses an old phrase known to a PC
scenes.spotlight: Give the first adversarial recognition moment to a PC whose active relationship has not yet appeared.

scenes.name: The Dead City They Remember
minimum: Move through the Rainline
Show one location that replaced something from 2274
Deliver an ally or loved-one familiarity reveal
scenes.cut: Use a montage with one meaningful decision instead of three location encounters.
scenes.failureForward: Failed investigation points toward a less comfortable source rather than removing information.
clues: Analogue date record surviving the purge
A current alias attached to an old access pattern
Proof the PCs were legally stored rather than executed
scenes.spotlight: Prioritise a social or investigative PC after the combat tutorial.

scenes.name: Anansi House Safehouse
minimum: Meet Marlowe
Open the relationship board
Learn that Palimpsest survived institutional transformation
Choose a lead into Virtuality or the spire
scenes.cut: Marlowe can deliver the core lead directly if table discussion is already rich.
scenes.failureForward: If the players distrust Marlowe, the same route appears in analogue safehouse records and a contact’s testimony.
clues: The eight fragments were deliberately separated
A benefactor financed the current sleeves
scenes.spotlight: Deliver one ally/loved-one reveal and one contradiction between PCs.

scenes.name: Palimpsest Virtuality
minimum: Reconstruct the 2274 final mission
Show old sleeves
Reveal at least one false or incomplete memory
Identify the modern adversarial coalition
optional: Personal virtual room for each PC
Encounter a copied impression of a contact
scenes.cut: Use three shared memory nodes rather than eight private scenes.
scenes.failureForward: Virtual damage changes Ego/resources or exposes a secret early; it never deletes the only copy of a critical clue.
clues: Archive architecture points to Anik’s route
Checksum proves all eight fragments belong together
scenes.spotlight: Every selected PC receives a memory beat; compress to a sentence for players already spotlighted heavily.

scenes.name: Needlecast Spire / Palimpsest Core
minimum: Allow infiltration, negotiation, hacking or assault
Put a personally connected adversary at the centre
Recombine enough evidence to make the final choice informed
scenes.cut: Remove secondary security zones and begin at the core once the party obtains valid access.
scenes.failureForward: Capture becomes negotiation inside the core; destroying one fragment still leaves redundant evidence sufficient to expose part of the truth.
clues: Complete Palimpsest procedure and publication path
scenes.spotlight: Call on each unresolved active relationship before the final decision.

scenes.name: Epilogues
minimum: Publish, suppress, destroy or seize Palimpsest
Resolve current-sleeve choice
Give each PC one relationship decision
scenes.cut: Use one sentence per PC if the session is over time.
scenes.failureForward: There is no single correct ending; consequences become campaign hooks.
scenes.spotlight: Every active PC gets the final word on their own identity.

redundancyRule: Every essential revelation must be obtainable through at least a PC memory, independent physical/virtual evidence, and NPC testimony or equivalent independent source.
